_comment_columns: Known columns on lcc_servicedefinition. Full schema lives in the dataverse-contact-api repo — fill in extra columns there if needed. Do NOT JSON.stringify lcc_servicedataschema here; the CLI script handles that.
_comment_required: lcc_servicedisplayname, lcc_servicetype, lcc_servicedataschema are the bare minimum to create a working row. The rest match the values existing services use.
lcc_servicedisplayname: <Service title — same string as service.json title>
lcc_servicedescription: <Service description — same string as service.json description>
lcc_servicetype: <slug — same as service.json id and folder name>

lcc_servicedataschema.name: metadata
lcc_servicedataschema.description: An array of key-value pairs to store custom metadata for the request
